{
  "name": "confirm-gate",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Pauses risky shell commands and edits that match your patterns and asks you to proceed or cancel with buttons.",
  "author": {
    "name": "i-noma-ru",
    "url": "https://github.com/i-noma-ru"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/i-noma-ru/claude-confirm-gate",
  "repository": "https://github.com/i-noma-ru/claude-confirm-gate",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "mod",
    "safety",
    "confirm",
    "tool-call"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "bash_patterns": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Bash command patterns",
      "description": "Case-insensitive JavaScript regular expressions tested against each Bash command. One match pauses the call.",
      "default": [
        "git( -C \\S+)? push[^\\n]* (--force|-f)\\b",
        "git( -C \\S+)? reset --hard",
        "git( -C \\S+)? clean -f",
        "git( -C \\S+)? checkout -- ",
        "git( -C \\S+)? restore "
      ]
    },
    "path_patterns": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Edited path patterns",
      "description": "Case-insensitive JavaScript regular expressions tested against the file path of Edit, Write and MultiEdit calls (backslashes normalized to slashes). Empty: paths are not checked.",
      "default": []
    }
  }
}
